comparisons.template: About 224 billion Marathons laid end to end span one light-year.
Trillions of Blue whales nose to tail still wouldn't cover one light-year.
Over 60 quadrillion Smartphones end to end would match one light-year.
More than 5 trillion Average humans stacked head to toe would reach one light-year.
Over 236 million trips around Earth's circumference span one light-year.
Every Grain of sand on Earth in a single line wouldn't come close to one light-year.
